summary: Iter105 - To Do List assign responsabile. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Verified GET /my/todo returns responsabile_id, GET /my/todo/assignees returns only org persons sorted by (cognome,nome), POST /my/todo/assign for tipo=attivita/followup/pipeline sets only responsabile_id (scadenza/priorita/stato/evento_id/event_id/data unchanged confirmed via direct Mongo compare), null removes assignment, foreign-org person -> 400, unknown id -> 404, non-admin member with empty attivita permissions -> 403. One real QA pipeline task was temporarily reassigned and restored to its original responsabile_id. GET /api/activities now includes responsabile_id for assigned items. UI desktop (1920x1080): logged in as qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it; dashboard shows todo-assign-{id}, popover todo-assign-menu-{id} opens, todo-assign-search filters list, clicking todo-assign-opt-{personId} saves and the trigger label updates to the person name, todo-assign-remove clears back to 'Assegna'. todo-filter-tipo-* and todo-filter-evento still present. UI mobile 390px: popover fits viewport (256px wide, offset 68). Activities page /attivita renders 'Responsabile' column. TEST_ activity + TEST_ followup created in QA org via POST /api/activities and /api/followups and deleted at end. Non-admin membership permissions restored.
critical_code_review_comments: home_widgets._query strips 'stato' key via q.pop('stato') before update to allow reassigning closed items; acceptable because the complete flow is handled separately. Note: assign still enforces responsabile scope for non-admin (sc['persona'] + None/empty), which may prevent a non-admin from reassigning a task that was already assigned to someone else—likely the intended behaviour.
AssignSelect returns a flat list of up to 5000 persons from /my/todo/assignees per load; cached per-component via loadPeople+useQuery would reduce calls. Not blocking.

normalize_permissions treats missing 'sections' dict as 'use defaults' (full access for role=user). This means setting membership permissions to {} does NOT restrict — restriction requires an explicit sections dict with empty arrays. Documented here for future test authors.
